propositions: materialize_tickets calls git checkout-index to write every blob fresh per resolution with no hardlinking or delta against prior entries, producing ~10^5x write amplification when adjacent ticket commits differ by one file
the tickets branch tip advances every ~26 seconds (1,374 commits in 10 hours), so the cache key has effectively zero reuse and behaves as an append-only log rather than a bounded reclaimable cache

measured store of 69,984 blobs (~620 MiB) produces sustained 4.4 GiB/h root-disk growth under five concurrent agents resolving attested gates, making this a throughput and resource-starvation problem as well as write waste

snapshot store byte accounting must charge shared inodes correctly to eviction policy (st_size/nlink for reporting, st_nlink==1 paths for incremental crediting) so the free-space watermark loop reclaims actual on-disk bytes

ADR 0005's content-addressed cache key design assumes reuse; the tickets key violates this assumption and requires integrity-preserving delta materialization (hardlink shared paths, git checkout-index only changed paths) or justification for the coarser key
